prerequisites: To enroll in this course, it is necessary to have passed or be enrolled in all subjects from courses prior to the one in which this subject is located.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the use of the psychrometric chart and processes with humid air.
Understand the basic principles of combustion.
learning_outcomes.code: B1 C21 D1 D2 D6 D10 D16 D17

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to basically evaluate any thermal process.
learning_outcomes.code: B1 C21 D1 D2 D6 D8 D10 D14 D16 D17

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic knowledge about thermal machines.
learning_outcomes.code: B1 C21 D1 D2 D8 D10 D17

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of combustion: Introduction. Types of combustion. Types of flame.
Fuels used in engines and thermal installations: Classification. Properties. Distribution of gaseous fuels.
Study of humid air: Introduction. Psychrometric variables. Psychrometric diagrams. Cooling towers.
Heat exchangers: Introduction. Classification. Heat balance. Temperature distribution. Exchanger analysis - LMTD method - NTU method.
Thermal machines and engines: Classification. Basic concepts.
Internal combustion engines: Real and theoretical cycles. Main components. Characteristic parameters. Characteristic curves. Auxiliary systems: cooling and lubrication.
Steam cycle power plants: Introduction. Main components. Rankine cycle. Heat balance.
Gas cycle power plants: Introduction. Main components. Brayton cycle. Heat balance. Combined gas-steam cycle.
Heat pumping: Definitions. Reverse Carnot cycle. Mechanical compression cycle. Heat pump. Absorption refrigeration. Refrigerants.
Boilers and Burners: Classification. Definitions. Types. Energy balance.
Compressors: Prior concepts. Reciprocating compressors. Rotary compressors.
Spillage processes: Stagnation properties. Speed of sound and Mach number. Isentropic flow through nozzles and diffusers.

Laboratory practicals: Determination of combustion enthalpy. Study of flame propagation. Hygrometric study of humid air. Study of heat exchangers. Study of 2-stroke engines. Study of 4-stroke engines. Study of air compressors. Energy balance of a boiler. Visit to a boiler room.
ICT-supported practicals: Calculation of an LPG tank.

assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 3.5 out of 10 is required for the problem solving and/or exercises exam. For the second opportunity (July call), students who chose continuous assessment can opt to keep their continuous assessment grade or take a specific test. Students who chose global assessment or are in the 'Fin de Carrera' call will be evaluated by a 100% global exam (theory and problems). Unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized electronic devices) will result in a failing grade (0.0) for the current academic year.
